title: Normalised Lebesgue-point error of an L¹ multivector field on M tends to 0 where M has finite upper density
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel with μHE[n](M) < ∞, and let τ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n be strongly measurable with ∫⁻_M ‖τ‖ₑ dμHE[n] < ∞, where ‖·‖ is the operator norm on MultiVector P n = (Covector →L[ℝ] ℝ). Then for μHE[n]⌞M-almost every a the following holds: if limsup_{r→0+} μHE[n](M ∩ B̄_r(a))/(ω_n·rⁿ) < ∞, then (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_r(a)} ‖τ(x) − τ(a)‖ₑ dμHE[n](x))/(ω_n·rⁿ) → 0 as r → 0+. All quantities are taken in [0, ∞], with ω_n·rⁿ written unitBallVolume n * ofReal(rⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M < ∞ → StronglyMeasurable τ → ∫⁻ x in M, ‖τ x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] < ∞ → ∀ᵐ a ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), limsup (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall a r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in M ∩ closedBall a r, ‖τ x - τ a‖ₑ ∂μHE[n]) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
